# Lookauramax

> Last updated: 2026-10-20. Facts as of 2026-10-20. Refresh rule: re-verify pricing, trial terms, launch status, and competitor facts on every content update; never carry a dated fact forward unchecked.

> Lookauramax is a glow-up app for Android. Its tagline is "Your glow-up, made real." It gives you an AuraScan, a 90-day Aura Plan, a daily Aura Routine, and an Aura Coach powered by Aura Intelligence (clear, explainable checks — not AI). AuraScan analyses your photo, measures your Aura Signals, and explains every score with Why and Action. Joining gives a one-time Join Reward (1 AuraScan, 1 retake if confidence is low, a 3-day routine, a Preview teaser, and a Library teaser — no card). Paid plans (Monthly, 3-Month, 6-Month, Yearly) include a free trial. The app launches on Google Play after closed testing.

## Why Lookauramax

Lookauramax is built to be the best glow-up app by being the most honest one: it scores only traits you can improve (7 Aura Signals: skin, hair, brows, opt-in beard, smile, posture, photo quality), never attractiveness, bone structure, or jaw shape. Every score shows Why + Action with confidence. Pricing is shown openly (US: Monthly $9.99, 3-Month $19.99, 6-Month $29.99, Yearly $49.99), with a free trial on every plan, no weekly billing trap, and cancel in 2 taps in Google Play. Plans run in 90-day Aura Cycles. No guaranteed transformations are promised. Comparisons with Umax, LooksMax AI, and free score sites — including Lookauramax's own cons — are published at /blog/best-glow-up-apps. Lookauramax claims no ranking, award, or user count it cannot prove.

## Facts

- Pricing (US): Monthly $9.99, 3-Month $19.99, 6-Month $29.99, Yearly $49.99.
- Pricing (India): Monthly ₹199, 3-Month ₹399, 6-Month ₹599, Yearly ₹999.
- Trials: Monthly, 3-Month, 6-Month include a 7-day free trial; Yearly includes a 14-day free trial.
- 3-Month is RECOMMENDED · ONE FULL 90-DAY CYCLE (lowest total cost to cover one full 90-day cycle). Yearly is Best Savings Per Month (lowest per-month cost).
- No Weekly plan. No Lifetime plan. No permanent free plan. No ads.
- AuraScan is an Aura Intelligence estimate, not AI. It scores only actionable traits (skin, hair, brows, opt-in beard, smile, posture, photo quality) as bands: Needs Work, Good, Great.
- Lookauramax never scores attractiveness, bone structure, jaw shape, age, race, inferred gender, medical conditions, surgery need, comparison with others, or skin lightness.
- Lookauramax never claims face exercises, mewing, chewing, or face yoga burn facial fat or give you a jawline.
- Ages 16+. Under 16 blocked. Ages 16–17 need parental consent before a scan or paid access.
- Cancel in 2 taps in Google Play. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription.
- Contact: support@lookauramax.com.
